templates.name: Posters on e-rickshaws
templates.summary: A small pilot: posters on a few e-rickshaws that pass the shop's market, with a way to count what comes of it. A starting point: change the steps to fit.

steps.title: Get at least three written quotations for the posters
steps.detail: Ask each for the full price, the poster size and material, and when it can be ready. Enter each as a quotation.

steps.title: Ask the e-rickshaw owners what they charge and for how many weeks
steps.detail: Get it in writing. Enter each figure as a quotation.

steps.title: Decide the one message and the offer on the poster
steps.detail: One clear line, the shop's name, and what a person should do next.

steps.title: Get the poster artwork made and check it
steps.detail: The Posters page can make a draft.

steps.title: Agree the routes and the hours with the riders
Put the posters up, and photograph each rickshaw
Count the people at the shop on the days before and on the days during
steps.detail: At least three days on each side, at the same hours.

steps.title: Ask every new customer how they heard of the shop
steps.detail: Enter the enquiries you can count.

signs: people counted at the shop before and during
customers who say they saw a rickshaw
the sales figures for the same days (shown apart from your counts)

templates.name: Pamphlets near the market
templates.summary: Hand out pamphlets with one offer for a short time, and count what comes of it. A starting point: change the steps to fit.

steps.title: Get at least three written quotations for printing the pamphlets
steps.detail: Ask each for the full price for the number you want, and when it can be ready. Enter each as a quotation.

steps.title: Decide the one offer and a way to tell which pamphlet brought a customer
steps.detail: For example a code on the pamphlet.

steps.title: Get the pamphlet made and check it
Brief whoever hands them out and agree where and when
Start handing them out, and photograph the place
Count the people at the shop on the days before and on the days during
steps.detail: At least three days on each side, at the same hours.

steps.title: Count the pamphlets that come back with the code

signs: people counted at the shop before and during
pamphlets brought back with the code
the sales figures for the same days (shown apart from your counts)
